# `project.company.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.company.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.company.set` (`SetCompany`): sets the company of the project, the panel builder (doc 16 §9.2 step 1).

- `name`: the name of the first party with role `panel_builder` (FR-PRJ-003; the title-block path
  `party.panel_builder.name`). Without such a party, a non-empty name appends one; an empty name then changes
  nothing. An empty name on an existing party removes its name and keeps the party (its address and other
  members stay).
- `notice`: the notice text of the title block (`project.notice`), stored as `notice` of the project-row
  member `COMPANY_MEMBER`; an empty text removes it (and the member when nothing else is left in it).
- `personal_data`: whether the panel-builder party is personal data (FR-PRJ-024, NFR-PRIV-06: "omit personal
  data" exports leave it out). A party this command appends is marked `true` unless the parameter says
  otherwise; without a party (and without a name that creates one) the parameter is refused.

An absent member leaves its value as it is; at least one member must be given (else invalid at the root).
Rejected: a project row whose `COMPANY_MEMBER` is not an object (a newer or damaged format; the command never
overwrites it). Only the project record changes. Bulk: the name and the notice are printed in every title
block, so front-ends preview the change. Undoable as one step. Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | [`CmdMlText`](#cmdmltext) or `null` | no |  | The company name (the panel-builder party's name); empty removes it; absent keeps it. |
| `notice` | [`CmdMlText`](#cmdmltext) or `null` | no |  | The title-block notice text (`project.notice`); empty removes it; absent keeps it. |
| `personal_data` | boolean or `null` | no |  | Whether the panel-builder party is personal data (FR-PRJ-024); absent keeps it (`true` for a new party). |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
